fichas.title: Meat Processing Plant
fichas.summary: A meat-processing plant with production on the ground floor and offices, laboratories, canteen, kitchen, washing and changing rooms on the first floor. Production includes sausages, cold meat, ham and delicatessen goods. The building accommodates groups of rooms with different temperature requirements and receives pork halves, beef quarters and coarsely dismembered wrapped pieces.
uses: Processing meat and producing sausages, cold meat, ham and delicatessen goods
Receiving and storing meat and packaged goods
Filling, cutting, mixing, smoking, cooling and packing products
Staff welfare, administration, laboratory work and plant support

WORKSHOPS
Meat Processing Plant
On the ground floor --> 0, sausages, cold meat, ham and delicatessen goods are produced in an area of 4500 m2 • Offices,
laboratories, canteen, kitchen, washing and changing rooms are
located on the first floor--> f). Daily production is about 25 t. The
building requires various groups of rooms with different room temperatures: social rooms, offices, WC, 20°C; production rooms,

18°C; air-conditioned rooms, 14-18°C; cool rooms, 10-12°C; cold
rooms, 0-8°C; deep-freeze, -20°C. High physical requirements for
construction and materials.
Production building: raw material is delivered in form of halves
of pork, quarters of beef and coarsely dismembered, wrapped
pieces.
